title: Past-Due Statement Payment through the Resident Portal (Community Rules & Site Care)
content:
A resident whose Community Rules & Site Care plan record is enrolled and who asks to pay the past-due part of the rules and site-care statement pays it in person through the resident portal, the payment naming the plan record whose statement it pays and being applied to the oldest charge first.

## When the past-due amount is worked out

The past-due amount is worked out only after the statement carries a vehicle permit fee for every month in which the site's registered vehicles exceeded its permit-free allowance.

The past-due amount is not worked out until the statement carries a registration-year fee for every registered pet in every registration year it has been registered.

## How the payment is made

`pay_site_care_past_due_0b8b512f` is the resident's own tool. The representative unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it through the resident portal. One run records one payment received today from the resident on the statement of the named plan record, through the channel the resident uses, and lowers the record's statement balance by the amount paid. The payment processor issues a confirmation number, which the resident sees in the receipt together with the new statement balance.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rules_plan_id` | the reference number of the resident's site-care plan record whose statement the payment names, as given to the resident by the representative from the site-care plan record lookup | identifier |
| `amount` | the amount the resident pays, in US dollars | positive number with 2 decimal places (cents); any further digits are rounded half up to the cent |
| `payment_channel` | how the payment reaches Hearthstone | exactly one of the values below |

| `payment_channel` value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `ach_autopay` | a recurring automatic bank draft the resident has authorised runs the payment |
| `online_portal_ach` | the resident pays from a checking or savings account through the resident portal |
| `online_portal_card` | the resident pays with a debit or credit card through the resident portal |
| `office_money_order` | a money order is handed in at the community office |
| `office_cashiers_check` | a cashier's check is handed in at the community office |
| `office_personal_check` | a personal check is handed in at the community office |

## Return

A successful run returns a receipt with status `received`, showing the statement reference of the payment, the plan record credited, the day received (YYYY-MM-DD), the amount, the channel as passed, the processor confirmation number, and the statement balance once the payment is applied. The tool defines no other outcome.
